domain: cross-round factual adjudication of prior findings' evidentiary claims (grep/read-verification of contested characterizations in the c-safe-abort-primitive-missing cluster)
axioms: A characterization of shipped code is a factual claim, not a taste call — it is adjudicated by reading the call sites, not by weighing which lens's narrative is more compelling
Refuting a sub-claim (drain flag is unread) does not overturn the parent finding's core confirmation (pause/resume exists, brief has no abort vocabulary) when the two are severable
A verified evidentiary correction changes how synthesis may phrase reused prior art, but does not by itself open a new scope gap unless the correction removes a capability synthesis was relying on
primitives: claim severability (which sub-claims survive a factual correction to a sibling sub-claim)
call-site verification (grep for reads, not just registration, before crediting a mechanism as wired)
citation hygiene (how a corrected characterization should be worded going forward)
failure_mode: Confined to re-litigating claims already on the ledger for this cluster — does not independently discover new locations or new clusters, so it cannot surface novel scope gaps outside what round 1-2 lenses already flagged

Because it operates only on the c-safe-abort-primitive-missing cluster, it cannot adjudicate contested claims elsewhere in the brief (e.g., c-lbkd-splice-defect, c-bzy-dual-tracked-fanout-eligibility) even if similar factual disputes exist there
